create_model: create a CLIP model from a config name with optional pretrained weights and precision settings
create_model_and_transforms: create a CLIP model along with train and validation image preprocessing transforms
load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch checkpoint state dict into an existing CLIP model with position embedding resizing
list_models: list all available CLIP model architecture names registered from model config JSON files
add_model_config: add a new model config directory or file path to the registry and rescan configs
